newsitem.title: BARBADOS: CRICKET-INDIA BAT FIRST IN THREE-DAY GAME AGAINST BARBADOS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-INDIA BAT FIRST IN THREE-DAY GAME AGAINST BARBADOS.

text.p: BRIDGETOWN, Barbados, March 22, Reuter - Barbados won the toss and put India in to bat on the opening day of the three-day match at the Kensington Oval on Saturday.
Barbados - Philo Wallace (captain), Sherwin Campbell, Adrian Griffith, Floyd Reifer, Stanton Proverbs, Courtney Browne, Vasbert Drakes, Ottis Gibson, Dave Marshall, Hendy Bryan, Patterson Thompson.
India - Navjot Sidhu (captain), Vngipurappu Laxman, Rahul Dravid, Saurav Ganguly, Sunil Joshi, Abey Kuruvilla, Ajay Jadeja, Robin Singh, Saba Karim, Dodanarsiah Ganesh, Noel David.
